doc_title: CONSENT FOR SECOND OR SUBSEQUENT CHARGE
doc_title_official: CONSENT FOR SECOND OR SUBSEQUENT CHARGE
when_used: A first chargee consents to a second or subsequent charge over the charged land and states how the two charges rank. The chargee is passed as the transferor and the chargor as the transferee, because the official execution prints the chargee first: the chargee is passed as a company party so that it seals under its common seal, the chargor signs as a natural person, and the borrower signs a block of its own from the borrower name field.

detail_rows.label: and if corporate the registered number, if any

body_text.text: The above named Chargee in respect of the Charge dated {{charge_date}} and registered as Entry Number {{charge_entry_numbers}} of the property comprised in the above noted Title HEREBY CONSENT to a Second or Subsequent Charge* over the Charged land to {{second_or_subsequent_chargee}};**
The Second or Subsequent Charge shall in point of security nand in relation to the Charge rank as follows (delete as applicable):-
*Give the full name and address of the second or subsequent charge(s)
IN WITNESS WHEROF the Chargee has signed this Consent as a deed.

extra_blocks.signed_label: SIGNED as a deed by the
